image_description: A Blenheim spaniel (Cavalier King Charles Spaniel) lying on a floral patterned bedspread. The dog has a white coat with rich chestnut/red patches, particularly on the ears and around the eyes. It is looking towards the camera with its tongue slightly out. The background includes soft bedding and some out-of-focus green plant leaves in the foreground.
